description:
Why Do Animals Hibernate? — Rock-a-bye baby on the tree top! When winter comes, why do bears, bats, and frogs go to sleep for months and months?
Kids science answer for "why do animals hibernate for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Winter brings scarce food and freezing temperatures. Hibernating animals drastically slow down their heartbeat, body temperature, and metabolism to live off stored fat until spring flowers bloom.
